verdict.rationale: Factory's code-review CI docs say Droid analyzes pull requests and merge requests, identifies issues, and posts feedback as inline comments. Its docs also advertise putting code review 'on autopilot across your repos', and droid exec is built for CI/CD pipelines, so automatic PR review fits that workflow. Missing for 10: detailed setup and trigger docs showing every PR is reviewed automatically (supported Git hosts, configuration, review-rule customization), and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.
